definitions.explanation: The period of one's life as a student, especially high school and university, usually looked back on from adulthood.

examples.japanese: {学生時代|がくせいじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧。
examples.english: A friend from my school days.

examples.japanese: {学生時代|がくせいじだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I traveled a lot when I was a student.

examples.japanese: {学生時代|がくせいじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}して→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧おけばよかった⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧になって⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Now I wish I had studied harder when I was a student.

notes:
⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ (student) + ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (period, days).
